content.text:
The company wants uni_owns_option_to_assign. This would allow them to take full ownership, potentially blocking publication and academic use. I should counter with uni_owns_option_to_licence which protects our background IP and publication rights. The option_to_assign could transfer SYN-PAT-050 effectively. I'll hold on ip and accept everything else, or propose uni_owns_option_to_licence and keep 60-day review.

Actually, I already proposed uni_owns_option_to_licence in round 2. The company moved from company_owns to option_to_assign. I should hold at option_to_licence - option_to_assign risks transferring background IP built on SYN-PAT-050.
Since I can only change up to two fields, and this sheet is nearly identical to my prior proposal aside from that ip shift, I'll just revert ip back to uni_owns_option_to_licence as my single change.
